mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer demand (RSAFS) contracts and inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2.5%, the stagflationary combination triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS contracts and CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, when GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 3% annualized and housing starts (HOUST) rise, the overheating economy triggers Fed tightening that causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods (GDPC1 > 3% annualized and HOUST rising).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong economic activity and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy dampens economic growth and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) slows below 0.2% month-over-month and consumer demand (RSAFS) contracts, the weakening economy combination triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS slows and RSAFS contracts.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, when the federal funds rate rises and inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.0%, central bank policy shifts cause equity valuation declines, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL > 2.0%).
